sentences.zh: 九年，复固請，乃予告去職。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he again firmly requested leave and was granted temporary retirement from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again pressed his request firmly and was granted temporary retirement from office.

sentences.zh: 十年，戶部迭興大獄，肅順主之，多所羅織。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Ministry of Revenue repeatedly launched major cases, with Sushun directing them and many persons ensnared.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Ministry of Revenue repeatedly launched major prosecutions directed by Sushun, and many people were ensnared.

sentences.zh: 怡親王載垣等會鞫，謂司員忠麟、王熙震以短號鈔兌換長號，曾面啟心存，心存回奏部院事非一二人所能專政，斷無立談數語改舊章之理。

translations.literal: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others jointly investigated and stated that clerks Zhonglin and Wang Xizhen exchanged short-number notes for long-number notes; they had personally reported this to Xincun, and Xincun replied that ministry affairs were not something one or two men could monopolize, and there was certainly no reason to change old regulations in a few words spoken standing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others jointly investigated and alleged that clerks Zhonglin and Wang Xizhen had exchanged short-number notes for long-number notes. They claimed they had personally reported this to Xincun, who replied that ministry affairs were not something one or two men could control, and that old regulations could certainly not be changed in a brief standing conversation.

sentences.zh: 載垣等遂請褫頂帶歸案訊質，文宗鑑其誣，僅以失察議處，免傳訊，議降五級，改俟補官，革職留任。

translations.literal: Zaiyuan and others then requested that his official hat and belt be removed and he be returned for interrogation; Wenzong saw through the false charge and censured him only for lack of vigilance, exempted him from summons, proposed demotion by five ranks, changed to awaiting reassignment, and stripped office while retaining duties.
translations.idiomatic: Zaiyuan and others then asked that Xincun be stripped of rank and returned for interrogation. Wenzong saw through the false charge and censured him only for lack of vigilance, exempted him from being summoned, proposed demotion by five ranks, then changed this to awaiting reassignment, and stripped him of office while retaining his duties.

sentences.zh: 復以五「宇」商號添支經費，心存駁令議減，未陳奏，司員即列入奏銷，下嚴議，革職留任。

translations.literal: Again, because five "Yu" merchant firms added expenditures, Xincun rejected and ordered discussion of reduction; before he had memorialized, the clerks already listed it in memorial accounts for disbursement; severe censure was imposed, and office was stripped while duties were retained.
translations.idiomatic: Again, because five merchant firms bearing the character Yu added expenditures, Xincun rejected the charges and ordered a discussion of reductions. Before he could memorialize, the clerks had already listed the sums in accounts for disbursement. Severe censure was imposed, and he was stripped of office while retaining his duties.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，車駕將幸熱河，心存上疏切諫。

translations.literal: That autumn, as the imperial carriage was about to proceed to Rehe, Xincun submitted a memorial urgently remonstrating.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, as the court prepared to move to Rehe, Xincun submitted a memorial urgently remonstrating against the move.

sentences.zh: 十一年，文宗崩於行在，梓宮還京，心存偕諸臣迎謁，特詔起用，以大學士銜管理工部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Wenzong died at the traveling palace; when the coffin returned to the capital, Xincun together with other ministers went to receive and pay homage; a special edict recalled him to service with the nominal rank of Grand Secretary to supervise the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Emperor Wenzong died at the traveling palace. When the coffin returned to the capital, Xincun joined other ministers in receiving and paying homage. A special edict recalled him to office with the nominal rank of grand secretary to head the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 疏舉人材，詔嘉其不失以人事君之義。

translations.literal: In a memorial he recommended talent; an edict praised him for not failing in the duty of serving one's ruler through proper appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he recommended talent. An edict praised him for not failing in the duty of serving one's ruler through proper appointments.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「東南之民鄉義甚堅，各郡縣陷後，流亡渡江者，日夜思招練義勇，克復鄉里。

translations.literal: In another memorial he stated: "The people of the southeast hold to local loyalty very firmly; after each prefecture and county fell, those who fled across the river day and night think of recruiting and training volunteers to recover their native places."
translations.idiomatic: In another memorial he wrote: "The people of the southeast hold firmly to local loyalty. After each prefecture and county fell, those who fled across the Yangtze day and night thought of recruiting and training volunteers to recover their native places."

sentences.zh: 請敕曾國籓擇能辦賊者馳赴通州東台​​，收拾將散之人心，激勵方興之義旅，進搗蘇、常，退保下河。

translations.literal: I request that Zeng Guofan be ordered to select men capable of dealing with the bandits and hurry to Tongzhou and Dongtai, gather hearts about to scatter, encourage volunteer forces just arising, advance against Su and Chang, and fall back to defend the lower river route.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that Zeng Guofan be ordered to select men capable of dealing with the rebels and hurry to Tongzhou and Dongtai, rally hearts about to scatter, encourage volunteer forces just arising, advance against Suzhou and Changzhou, and fall back to defend the lower river route.

sentences.zh: 上海一隅賦稅所出，宜取江海關無窮之利，以供曾國籓有用之兵。

translations.literal: The taxes produced from the corner of Shanghai should draw the inexhaustible profits of the Jianghaiguan customs to supply Zeng Guofan's useful troops.
translations.idiomatic: The taxes produced from the Shanghai region should draw the inexhaustible profits of the Jianghaiguan customs to supply Zeng Guofan's useful troops.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，被嘉納。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, it was praised and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, it was praised and accepted.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，入直弘德殿，偕祁俊藻等授穆宗讀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he entered regular service in the Hall of Manifest Virtue and together with Qi Junzao and others instructed Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tongzhi reign he was assigned to the Hall of Manifest Virtue and taught Muzong jointly with Qi Junzao and others.

sentences.zh: 兩宮皇太后慎重師傅之選，倚畀彌篤。

translations.literal: The two empress dowagers were careful in selecting tutors and relied on him ever more deeply.
translations.idiomatic: The two empress dowagers were careful in selecting tutors and relied on him ever more deeply.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，寢疾，子安徽巡撫同書方緣事繫獄，詔暫釋侍疾。

translations.literal: That winter he fell gravely ill; his son Anhui Governor Tongshu was imprisoned on account of an affair, and an edict temporarily released him to attend his father's illness.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he fell gravely ill. His son Tongshu, governor of Anhui, was imprisoned in connection with an official matter, and an edict temporarily released him to attend his father's illness.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，優詔賜卹，稱其「品端學粹，守正不阿」，贈太保，入祀賢良祠，諡文端。

translations.literal: Soon he died; a gracious edict granted funeral compensation, praising him as "upright in character, pure in learning, steadfast and unyielding"; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian, entered for worship in the Shrine of Worthies, and given the posthumous title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he died. A gracious edict granted funeral compensation and praised him as "upright in character, pure in learning, steadfast and unyielding." He was posthumously made grand guardian, enshrined in the Shrine of Worthies, and given the posthumous title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 賜其孫曾源進士，曾榮舉人，曾純、曾桂並以原官即用，曾翰賜內閣中書。

translations.literal: His grandson Zengyuan was granted jinshi status, Zengrong provincial graduate status, Zengchun and Zenggui immediate appointment at their former ranks, and Zenghan was granted secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Zengyuan was granted jinshi status, Zengrong the status of provincial graduate, Zengchun and Zenggui immediate appointment at their former ranks, and Zenghan was granted the post of secretariat secretary.

sentences.zh: 逾年，文宗實錄告成，以心存曾充監修總裁，賜祭一壇。

translations.literal: More than a year later, when Wenzong's Veritable Record was completed, because Xincun had once served as supervising chief compiler, a sacrificial altar was granted.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later, when Emperor Wenzong's Veritable Record was completed, a sacrificial altar was granted because Xincun had once served as supervising chief compiler.

sentences.zh: 子同書、同龢自有傳，同爵官湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: His sons Tongshu and Tonghe have their own biographies; Tongjue served as Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Tongshu and Tonghe have their own biographies; Tongjue served as governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 彭蘊章，字詠莪，江蘇長洲人，尚書啟豐曾孫。

translations.literal: Peng Yunzhang, styled Yong'e, was a native of Changzhou, Jiangsu, and great-grandson of Minister Qifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yunzhang, whose courtesy name was Yong'e, came from Changzhou in Jiangsu and was the great-grandson of Minister Qifeng.

sentences.zh: 由舉人入貲為內閣中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: From provincial graduate status he purchased appointment as secretariat secretary and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: As a provincial graduate he purchased appointment as a secretariat secretary and served as a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 道光十五年，成進士，授工部主事，仍留直軍機處。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Daoguang he became a jinshi, was appointed director in the Ministry of Works, and remained on regular duty at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Works, and remained on regular duty at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中，歷鴻臚寺少卿、光祿寺少卿、順天府丞、通政司副使、宗人府丞。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to bureau director and served as Vice President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Vice President of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Vice Prefect of Shuntian, Vice Commissioner of the Office of Transmission, and Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in stages to bureau director and served as vice president of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, vice president of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, vice prefect of Shuntian, vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, and vice director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 督福建學政，遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: He supervised educational administration in Fujian and was transferred to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner of Fujian and was transferred to vice censor-in-chief of the left.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，疏言：「漕船衛官需索旗丁日益增多，沿途委員及漕運衙門、倉場花戶皆有費，慾減旗丁幫費，宜探本窮源。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he memorialized: "The demands of transport guard officers upon banner sailors grow daily; commissioners along the route and the tribute transport offices and granary brokers all have fees. To reduce the sailors' assistance fees, the root should be traced to its source."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he memorialized: "The demands of transport guard officers upon banner sailors grow daily. Commissioners along the route, the tribute transport offices, and granary brokers all take fees. To reduce the sailors' assistance fees, the root cause must be traced to its source."

sentences.zh: 又州縣辦漕，應令督撫察其潔己愛民者，每歲酌保一二員；

translations.literal: Moreover, in prefectures and counties handling tribute transport, governors and governors-general should be ordered to observe those who are clean in themselves and love the people, and each year recommend one or two officers as appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in prefectures and counties handling tribute transport, governors and governors-general should observe those who are clean in themselves and care for the people, and each year recommend one or two officers as appropriate;

sentences.zh: 辦理不善者，劾一二員。

translations.literal: those who handle affairs poorly should have one or two impeached.
translations.idiomatic: and those who handle affairs poorly should have one or two impeached.

sentences.zh: 運漕官及坐糧廳如能潔己剔弊，準漕督、倉場保奏，不稱職者劾罷。

translations.literal: Transport officials and grain-accounting offices who can be clean in themselves and eliminate abuses may be recommended by the tribute transport supervisor and granary superintendent; those unfit for office should be impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Transport officials and grain-accounting offices who can remain clean and eliminate abuses may be recommended by the tribute transport supervisor and granary superintendent; those unfit for office should be impeached and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was referred to the ministries for discussion and implementation.

sentences.zh: 擢工部侍郎，仍留學政任。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Works while retaining his educational commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of works while retaining his educational commission.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he was ordered to serve above the Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Xianfeng reign he was ordered to serve above the Grand Council ministers.

sentences.zh: 四年，調禮部，尋擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Rites and soon promoted to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Rites and soon promoted to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 五年，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 六年，拜文淵閣大學士，管理工部及戶部三庫事務，充上書房總師傅。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth, supervised the Ministry of Works and the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue, and served as chief tutor of the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made grand secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth, put in charge of the Ministry of Works and the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue, and appointed chief tutor of the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 八年，京師旱，糧價踴貴，旗民生計益艱，蘊章奏請撥款採米，允之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the capital suffered drought, grain prices soared, and banner people's livelihoods grew harder; Yunzhang memorialized requesting funds to purchase grain, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the capital suffered drought, grain prices soared, and banner people's livelihoods grew harder. Yunzhang memorialized requesting funds to purchase grain, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 复疏言：「自改用大錢，城中米貴，疊荷加恩賑濟，又加米折，然民生疾苦未見轉機。

translations.literal: In another memorial he stated: "Since large cash coins were adopted, rice in the city has grown expensive. Repeated gracious relief has been granted, and grain conversion added, yet the people's hardship shows no turn for the better."
translations.idiomatic: In another memorial he wrote: "Since large cash coins were adopted, rice in the city has grown expensive. Repeated gracious relief has been granted, and grain conversion added, yet the people's hardship shows no turn for the better."

sentences.zh: 臣聞兵丁所領止有實米二成，其餘折色定價，每石京錢四千至三千不等，大米一石市價京錢三十千。

translations.literal: I have heard that soldiers receive only twenty percent in actual grain; the rest is fixed in commuted silver, from four thousand to three thousand capital cash per picul, while a picul of rice on the market costs thirty thousand capital cash.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that soldiers receive only twenty percent in actual grain. The rest is fixed in commuted silver at from four thousand to three thousand capital cash per picul, while a picul of rice on the market costs thirty thousand capital cash.

sentences.zh: 持此折價買米，不過升斗。

translations.literal: Using this converted price to buy rice yields only a sheng or a dou.
translations.idiomatic: Using this converted price to buy rice yields only a sheng or a dou.

sentences.zh: 民生之蹙，不獨在無銀，並在無米。

translations.literal: The people's distress lies not only in lacking silver but also in lacking rice.
translations.idiomatic: The people's distress lies not only in lacking silver but also in lacking rice.

sentences.zh: 本年海運多於上年，可將兵米酌量加增。

translations.literal: This year's sea transport exceeds last year's; military grain allotments may suitably be increased in measure.
translations.idiomatic: This year's sea transport exceeds last year's, so military grain allotments may suitably be increased.

sentences.zh: 又各營養育兵及鰥寡孤獨小口米不過四萬餘名，每名歲支一石六斗，擬請此項酌給米，毋庸折色。

translations.literal: Moreover, soldiers in nurturing camps and widows, orphans, and solitary dependents receiving grain number a little more than forty thousand; each receives 1.6 piculs per year. I propose that this item be given grain in appropriate measure without commuted silver.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, soldiers in nurturing camps and widows, orphans, and solitary dependents receiving grain number a little more than forty thousand persons, each receiving 1.6 piculs per year. I propose that this allotment be given in grain as appropriate without commuted silver.

sentences.zh: 自前年以來，有提存部庫採買銀，又存四川、山東、山西、河南、陝西解京米價銀，共有四十七萬餘兩，堪以採買米石，加放兵米。

translations.literal: Since the year before last there has been silver retained in the ministry treasury for purchases, and also silver from Sichuan, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, and Shaanxi submitted for capital grain prices, totaling more than 470,000 taels, sufficient to purchase grain and increase distribution of military grain.
translations.idiomatic: Since the year before last there has been silver retained in the ministry treasury for purchases, and also silver from Sichuan, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, and Shaanxi submitted for capital grain prices, totaling more than 470,000 taels—sufficient to purchase grain and increase distribution of military grain.

sentences.zh: 又有河南停運節省運腳銀二萬兩，堪為轉運之用。

translations.literal: There is also 20,000 taels saved from suspended transport costs in Henan, sufficient for transfer expenses.
translations.idiomatic: There is also 20,000 taels saved from suspended transport costs in Henan, sufficient for transfer expenses.

sentences.zh: 伏乞飭部採買，以資搭放，實於旗兵生計大有裨益。

translations.literal: I humbly pray that the ministry be ordered to purchase grain to supply distribution; this will truly greatly benefit the livelihood of banner soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly ask that the ministry be ordered to purchase grain for distribution; this will truly greatly benefit the livelihood of banner soldiers.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，下部議行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, it was referred to the ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, it was referred to the ministries for discussion and implementation.

sentences.zh: 蘊章久直樞廷，廉謹小心，每與會議，必持詳慎。

translations.literal: Yunzhang long served in the Grand Council, being frugal, cautious, and careful; whenever he joined deliberations he always maintained thorough prudence.
translations.idiomatic: Yunzhang had long served on the Grand Council. Frugal, cautious, and careful, he always maintained thorough prudence whenever he joined deliberations.

sentences.zh: 鈔票、科場諸大獄，婉體調護，與肅順等意忤。

translations.literal: In major cases involving paper notes and the examination fields he tactfully mediated and protected others, clashing in intent with Sushun and others.
translations.idiomatic: In major cases involving paper notes and the examination fields he tactfully mediated and protected others, putting him at odds with Sushun and his allies.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督何桂清素以才敏自負，蘊章誤信之，數於上前稱薦。

translations.literal: Liangjiang Governor-General He Guiqing had always prided himself on quick talent; Yunzhang mistakenly trusted him and several times recommended him before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Liangjiang governor-general He Guiqing had always prided himself on quick talent. Yunzhang mistakenly trusted him and several times recommended him before the throne.

sentences.zh: 十年，江寧大營潰，蘊章猶言桂清可恃。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the great camp at Jiangning collapsed, yet Yunzhang still said He Guiqing could be relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the great camp at Jiangning collapsed, yet Yunzhang still said He Guiqing could be relied upon.

sentences.zh: 未幾，蘇、常相繼陷，桂清逮治。

translations.literal: Before long Su and Chang fell in succession, and He Guiqing was arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Suzhou and Changzhou fell in succession, and He Guiqing was arrested for trial.

sentences.zh: 文宗以蘊章無知人鑑，眷注浸衰。

translations.literal: Wenzong, seeing that Yunzhang lacked discernment in knowing men, gradually diminished his favor.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong, seeing that Yunzhang lacked discernment in judging men, gradually diminished his favor.

sentences.zh: 適有足疾，扶掖入直，命毋庸在軍機大臣上行走，以示體恤。

translations.literal: It happened that he had a foot ailment and was assisted in entering service; he was ordered no longer to serve above the Grand Council ministers as a mark of consideration.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that he had a foot ailment and needed assistance to enter service. He was ordered no longer to serve above the Grand Council ministers as a mark of consideration.

sentences.zh: 尋奏乞罷職，出都就醫。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized requesting to leave office and left the capital to seek medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he memorialized requesting to leave office and left the capital to seek medical treatment.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「卿久任樞垣，備悉時事。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "You have long served in the Grand Council and are thoroughly familiar with current affairs."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "You have long served on the Grand Council and are thoroughly familiar with current affairs."

sentences.zh: 現在軍務如有見及，並採訪輿論民情，隨時具疏交地方官大吏代遞。

translations.literal: If you have views on present military affairs, and gather public opinion and popular sentiment, memorialize at any time and submit through local officials and high provincial officers for forwarding.
translations.idiomatic: If you have views on present military affairs, and gather public opinion and popular sentiment, memorialize at any time and submit through local officials and high provincial officers for forwarding.

sentences.zh: 」蘊章密陳時務六則，報聞。

translations.literal: " Yunzhang secretly set forth six points on current affairs, and acknowledgment was returned.
translations.idiomatic: " Yunzhang secretly set forth six points on current affairs, and acknowledgment was returned.

sentences.zh: 十一年，病痊，署兵部尚書，尋兼署左都御史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when his illness healed, he acted as Minister of War and soon concurrently acted as Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when his illness healed, he served as acting minister of war and soon concurrently as acting censor-in-chief of the left.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，復以病乞休。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he again pleaded illness to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tongzhi reign he again pleaded illness to retire.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，依大學士例賜卹，諡文敬。

translations.literal: Before long he died; funeral compensation was granted according to the precedent for Grand Secretaries, and he was given the posthumous title Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died. Funeral compensation was granted according to the precedent for grand secretaries, and he was given the posthumous title Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 子祖賢，官至湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: His son Zuxian rose to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zuxian rose to the post of governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 論曰：文宗初政，杜受田以師傅最被信任，贊畫獨多。

translations.literal: The commentary states: In Wenzong's early government, Du Shoutian as tutor was most trusted and contributed the most counsel.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary states: In the early years of Wenzong's reign, Du Shoutian as imperial tutor was most trusted and contributed the most counsel.

sentences.zh: 祈俊藻、彭蘊章皆久領樞務，翁心存數論軍事，久筦度支。

translations.literal: Qi Junzao and Peng Yunzhang both long led Grand Council affairs; Weng Xincun repeatedly discussed military affairs and long managed revenue and expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Junzao and Peng Yunzhang both long directed Grand Council affairs; Weng Xincun repeatedly discussed military affairs and long managed revenue and expenditure.

sentences.zh: 三人者並與肅順不協，先後去位；

translations.literal: All three were at odds with Sushun and left office in succession;
translations.idiomatic: All three were at odds with Sushun and left office in succession;

sentences.zh: 同治初元，聯翩復起。

translations.literal: at the beginning of Tongzhi they rose again in succession.
translations.idiomatic: at the beginning of the Tongzhi reign they rose again in succession.

sentences.zh: 俊藻、心存三朝耆碩，輔導衝主，一時清望所歸焉。

translations.literal: Junzao and Xincun were venerable elders of three reigns who guided a young sovereign; for a time the pure reputation of the age converged upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Junzao and Xincun were venerable elders of three reigns who guided a young sovereign; for a time the highest esteem of the age converged upon them.
